reason: 一次本文を確認したが、既存系統との関連またはLLM推論効率への効果が弱い/間接的で、追加の具体的検証が必要なためborderlineに残す。 The paper discusses the need and challenges of large human language models, including languages and deployment/resource concerns, but is a broad position/survey-style treatment without a concrete inference optimization evaluated against serving metrics.
title: Large Human Language Models: A Need and the Challenges
